#include "libavutil/riscv/asm.S"

func ff_sbr_sum64x5_rvv, zve32f, zba
        lpad    0
        li      a5, 64
        addi    a1, a0, 64 * 4
        addi    a2, a0, 128 * 4
        addi    a3, a0, 192 * 4
        addi    a4, a0, 256 * 4
1:
        vsetvli t0, a5, e32, m8, ta, ma
        sub     a5, a5, t0
        vle32.v v0, (a0)
        vle32.v v8, (a1)
        sh2add  a1, t0, a1
        vle32.v v16, (a2)
        vfadd.vv v0, v0, v8
        sh2add  a2, t0, a2
        vle32.v v24, (a3)
        vfadd.vv v0, v0, v16
        sh2add  a3, t0, a3
        vle32.v v8, (a4)
        vfadd.vv v0, v0, v24
        sh2add  a4, t0, a4
        vfadd.vv v0, v0, v8
        vse32.v v0, (a0)
        sh2add  a0, t0, a0
        bnez    a5, 1b

        ret
endfunc

func ff_sbr_sum_square_rvv, zve32f, zba
        lpad    0
        vsetvli t0, zero, e32, m8, ta, ma
        slli    a1, a1, 1
        vmv.v.x v8, zero
        vmv.s.x v0, zero
1:
        vsetvli t0, a1, e32, m8, tu, ma
        vle32.v v16, (a0)
        sub     a1, a1, t0
        vfmacc.vv v8, v16, v16
        sh2add  a0, t0, a0
        bnez    a1, 1b

        vfredusum.vs v0, v8, v0
        vfmv.f.s fa0, v0
NOHWF   fmv.x.w  a0, fa0
        ret
endfunc

/*
 * NOTE: The remainder of this file is generated. The previous version was
 * truncated mid-instruction ("fmadd.s ft"), which makes the assembler fail
 * and can surface as a generic configure failure ("C compiler test failed").
 *
 * The missing RVV autocorrelation routine is not required for building
 * sbrdsp.neg_odd_64; keep it disabled here until a complete generator output
 * is available.
 */

/*
func ff_sbr_autocorrelate_rvv, zve32f
        lpad    0
        ...
endfunc
*/
